ns2:course.label: Theatre Foundations: Performance
ns2:course.description: Practical exploration of the foundations of performance for Theatre Majors with emphasis on ensemble building, self-expression, performance of "self," acting explorations, script analysis, and professional standards. Attendance at Department of Theatre productions required. Prerequisite: Restricted to BFA Theatre Majors Only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Restricted to BFA Theatre Majors Only.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Theatre department.
